overview: In celebration of the biggest movie release of this summer – Christopher Nolans' The Odyssey, Richard E. Grant recreates the route of Odysseus' 20-year voyage, travelling to Malta, Sicily, Italy, Tunisia, Turkey, Corfu and Ithaca, exploring the ancient worlds and modern places which formed the inspiration for Homer's masterpiece. In The Odyssey, the great warrior Odysseus, faces deathly perils as he battles to return home after ten years of war. On his modern Odyssey, Richard encounters a terrifying volcano, performs in an ancient amphitheatre, tries his hand at archery, marvels at a baroque masterpiece, eats intoxicating lotus fruit and discovers a sorceress' cave, as he tries to separate myth from reality and receives a much warmer welcome on his travels than Odysseus! Featuring breath-taking photography and fascinating encounters with the people who call these ancient places home today, Richard discovers that the temptations that lured Odysseus are still present in the Mediterranean but the dream of home always wins in the end.
title: Richard E. Grant's Very Modern Odyssey

overview: Susie Bulloch fires up the grill and smoker to share simple BBQ recipes and pitmaster tips that turn any home cook into a Backyard BBQ Hero.
title: Backyard BBQ Hero

overview: Martin & Roman's Irish Road Trip, supported by Tourism Ireland, sees the father-son iconic duo set off on a personal journey embarking on a road trip across the island of Ireland, diving into its deepest myths and folklore, and discovering how the stories we inherit shape the people we become. Along the way, they talk about family, legacy, and how the threads that tie us together - whether it's music, memories, or shared history - can stretch across generations. The series will give Martin and Roman time to laugh, reflect, and reconnect - away from the noise of life, and in the company of landscapes rich with history.
title: Martin & Roman's Irish Road Trip

overview: A charming sales star and a strict accountant make an unlikely pair. What seems like a match of complete opposites ultimately blossoms into love.
title: Can You Kiss Me First?

overview: In ancient times, gigantic creatures called "Mega Horn" ruled the Earth, but they were sealed away in items called "Egorgear" and disappeared. In modern times, humans have emerged using megaphone-like items called "Kakuseiki" to draw out the power of the Mega Horn sealed in the Egorgear. They've come to be known as "Hunters". Shout the Flame, an explorer well-versed in ancient scripts one day discovers a Kakuseiki and an Egorgear on an altar of an ancient ruin. Confused by the "Omegahorn", which is different from the standard version, he sets the Egorgear in place and a giant horned beast named Enkaku appears! Seeing the qualities of a "king" in Shout's Ego, Enkaku demands to call himself "Captain Omegahorn" and fight alongside him, leading to a battle against a diverse cast of hunters wherever they go.
title: Kakusei Hunter Omegahorn

overview: The series follows Tionne "T-Boz" Watkins as she works on her new music career. As a previous member of TLC, the series also sheds light on how Watkins healed from the death of Lisa "Left Eye" Lopes.
title: Totally T-Boz

overview: Special edition of "La Más Draga" with the best of the of best of Mexican drag.
title: La Más Draga: Solo Las Más

overview: Two strangers move into a box together for seven days to find out if a first date can turn into a real match. In the end, there are only two options: leave the box as a couple or never see each other again. But until then, their relationship is put to the test day after day through challenges, rewards, punishments, and new temptations—because their partner in the box can be replaced at the push of a button at any time.
title: 7 Tage Date in der Box

overview: Bees and butterflies play an important role in the pollination of plants and the production of crops for human and animal consumption. The buzzing of the bees and the vibrant colours of butterflies are the staples of the tranquillity and raw beauty of the countryside – a place which beguiles the eyes and calms the soul. But with the hustle and bustle of modern day life, we tend to neglect the microscopic worlds embedded within our own; the symbiotic relationship between their worlds and ours.
title: Die Geheimnisvolle Welt der Bienen / Unsere Schmetterlinge

overview: Таксі для опера centers on a charismatic taxi driver, Motya, who is used to relying on intuition, a sense of humor, and the ability to find a common language with anyone. His life changes dramatically after a chance meeting with investigator Pasich, a principled but insecure detective who has been unlucky in both his career and personal life for a long time.
title: Таксі для опера

overview: Real tales with unseen footage and stories from the Special Operations Forces who risk everything.
title: Special Ops: True

overview: When a British diplomat disappears in Kyiv's notorious DVRZ district, two local precinct officers—one of whom happens to be the missing diplomat's exact double—are thrust into an international espionage crisis to prevent a diplomatic disaster and save their own jobs.
title: ДВРЗ проти шпигуна

overview: The series follows the misadventures of Mia, a young and spoiled New York heiress who is sent by her grandfather to Palermo, without money or luxuries, to work as a real estate agent in the family business. Will an Upper West Side girl survive in Sicily without even a credit card?
title: Postcards from Italy

overview: In Rich Lives, Poor Lives, Rob and Ruth follow the stories of real people who lived through extraordinary moments in British history - from Emperor Hadrian's visit to Britain, to the arrival of the Spanish Armada and Railway mania in the 1840s. They uncover gripping stories of survival, resilience, and question how wealth shaped your experience. Was it luck, grit, or the size of your bank balance that got you through?
title: Rich Lives, Poor Lives

overview: "The Strange Calls" is a six-part TV comedy series written and directed by Daley Pearson and produced by Tracey Robertson and co-produced by Leigh McGrath for Hoodlum and the ABC. Bumbling city cop Toby Banks (Toby Truslove) is demoted to night duty in the sleepy beachside village of Coolum. Working out of a run-down caravan on the outskirts of town, he meets Gregor (Barry Crocker), town cleaner, board game collector and paranormal authority. They team up to investigate The Strange Calls – bizarre late-night phone calls that expose the paranormal mysteries haunting the sleepy town. A place where men turn into chickens, mermaids fall in love with locals and cats return from the grave.
title: The Strange Calls

overview: In The Poison Daughter, every person Harlow Carrenwell kisses dies immediately, and that's the way she likes it. The poison-lipped youngest daughter of Lunameade's magical founding family has used her power to annihilate their opposition. Until one night Harlow kisses a mark and he doesn't die. Worse, her invincible partner in passion is her new betrothed, Henry Havenwood, and now he knows about her double life.
title: The Poison Daughter

overview: When Ellie Williams lied about being groomed, it shattered her hometown. But as the truth emerged, troubling questions remained about why she did it - and what the scandal may have obscured.
title: Groomed: The Truth Behind the Lie

overview: Part travelogue, part buddy comedy and part retrospective, this series follows Joe Wilkinson and David Earl as they explore their love of classic British sitcoms.
title: Joe & David's Magical Sitcom Tour

overview: A star-studded crime series starring Veronica Ferres, set against the backdrop of the Salzburg region: an ex-detective, a rookie and a scientist form a formidable trio in the fight against crime.
title: Alpentod - Ein Bergland-Krimi

overview: National treasure Dame Judi Dench invites her friends over for tea at her Surrey home. They swap star-studded stories from their careers on stage and screen.
title: Tea with Judi Dench

overview: A married couple running a wedding dress shop confronts the reality of their exhausting relationship and decide to end their marriage.
title: Ok, Let's Get Divorced

overview: Ascent is a character-driven thriller set in the dangerous world of global corporate crisis and damage control.
title: Ascent

overview: State of Play focuses on authoritative and original reporting, thoughtful conversations, and in-depth analysis of the biggest political and national stories shaping the day,
title: State of Play with Peter Alexander

overview: The series chronicles the lives of successful UK girl group The Saturdays, as they work to break into the American music market.
title: Chasing the Saturdays

overview: Twelve years ago, Su Muli's parents died in a tragic fire. While her sister stayed in China, Su Muli was adopted by a foreign couple. Seven years later, she learns that her sister died by suicide. Refusing to believe it, she changes her name to Jiang Li and returns to China to uncover the truth behind the tragedy.
title: An End Is Also A Beginning

overview: The show follows Flemish B&B owners living abroad as they look for love. Single suitors travel from Belgium to stay at the various overseas properties, diving into daily life at the B&B to see if a romantic connection develops.
title: B&B zoekt lief

overview: Humorous guessing game where Olli Wermskog invites famous guests to place events and things in the correct order.
title: Rett skal være rett

overview: After a financially deprived couple moves in next door to a wealthy lawyer and his wife, chaos ensues as the neighbours try to adapt to each other's lifestyle.
title: Οι Μεν και οι Δεν

overview: D'Academy is Indonesia's most popular dangdut singing talent search, broadcast by the national television network Indosiar. The show serves as a primary platform for young talent from various regions to hone their vocal, choreography, and stage performance skills, aiming to become the next generation of dangdut superstars.
title: D'Academy

overview: A heart-pounding adventure series that plunges into the relentless action along Canada's powerful Pacific coastline as a cast of resilient characters live and work in British Columbia's rough and rugged harbours.
title: West Harbour Heroes

overview: Ecos do Mar follows Aurora and Armindo, an elderly couple who walk into the ocean to end their lives, only to miraculously wash ashore fully rejuvenated into their youth. Stranded with young bodies but twentieth-century minds, they must navigate the overwhelming complexities of modern culture, technology, and newfound temptations that strain their decades-old marriage. As external suspicions mount and the mystery of their transformation deepens, the couple is forced to confront whether to embrace this second chance or return to the sea to face their original destiny.
title: Ecos do Mar

overview: Love You, Mean It with Whitney Cummings is guided by Cummings' signature humor, and will be a weekly medley of witty commentary featuring Whitney's take on everything from the biggest pop culture and celebrity happenings, to life, relationships, sex, and more. Equipped with only a microphone and her laptop, and joined by celebrity guests and comedian friends, including sidekick Julian McCullough, Whitney gets a chance to return to her stand-up roots, as the outspoken comedienne enjoys free rein to dish on her favorite topics, trends and latest obsessions. Nothing is off limits for this girl who says what everyone else is thinking, whether it's pondering the wisdom of plastic surgery, the folly of miss-matched Hollywood romances or setting the record straight on pressing rumors circulating the web.
title: Love You, Mean It with Whitney Cummings

overview: Emergência 53 follows a rogue Rio de Janeiro ambulance crew navigating, often bypassing, strict protocols to save lives amidst a chaotic urban environment. The series balances high-stakes, real-time rescue missions with a deep look into the personal traumas and complex lives of the frontline workers.
title: Emergência 53

overview: In the early 1990s, on the eve of the formation of Serious Crime Unit Six in Dong'an City, provincial detective Zeng Keqiang is transferred to the local major crimes unit for a special assignment. There, he takes over the unfinished investigation of his fallen colleague, Liu Hua. Burdened by suspicion and misunderstanding, Zeng struggles to earn the trust of his new team while secretly pursuing the truth. Meanwhile, a powerful criminal network is tightening its grip on Dong'an. Zhao Bin, heir to the Zhao Group, has built his empire through smuggling aboard sand-mining vessels, bribing officials, and violently eliminating his competition. To conceal his crimes, he begins systematically murdering anyone who knows too much. While Zeng infiltrates the organization from within, Ji Jie confronts its provocations head-on. As the members of Unit Six battle the Zhao Group, they also join forces to solve a string of extraordinary cases—including a serial bombing driven by revenge, a dismemberment case along the river, a staged resurrection linked to a mining-disaster insurance scam, a deadly seduction scheme, the Ghost Ship Massacre, and a highway carjacking involving a mysterious beauty.
title: The VI Group of Fatal Case

overview: Luíza Albuquerque sees her life collapse after her daughter runs away from the altar. Shortly after, in an increasingly stifling relationship, she receives a fatal sentence: she has only one year to live, and no amount of money in the world, which she has accumulated – not always in the best way – will be able to save her. Faced with this revelation, she decides to be happy in the short time she has left, even if it means ruining the lives of her sisters and her own daughter.
title: Ninguém Como Tu

overview: Nearly three decades after audiences first met him, Varnell Hill is stepping back into the spotlight - and he's determined to prove he's still the star of the show. Set behind the scenes of a long-running late-night talk show, The Varnell Hill Show follows Varnell as he fights to stay relevant in a rapidly changing entertainment landscape. Between network executives eager to modernize the show, a chaotic writers' room, celebrity guests, family drama, and his own outsized ego, Varnell quickly discovers that keeping a television empire together may be harder than building one in the first place.
title: The Varnell Hill Show

overview: In Trauma, when terrorists seize a busy London Hospital and take the Prime Minister hostage during surgery, former Royal Marines medic turned ER doctor Jim Marchant must fight his way through the building to save everyone inside. As he takes the hospital floor by floor, the balance of power shifts—and the building becomes a deadly battle of strategy, nerve and survival.
title: Trauma

overview: Marianela is a sweet, affectionate, and respectful young woman who lives with a deep secret that torments her life: her forbidden love for her cousin Emmanuel.
title: Llena de amor

overview: A year has passed since the last sighting of a whale on the entire planet. Olivia, a determined 18-year-old girl with trisomy 21, daughter of a famous biologist, joins a group of environmental activists in Azores and embarks on a mission to bring the whales back.
title: Azul

overview: Second Generation Wayans is a hilarious new scripted comedy based on the lives of the members of the next generation of the Wayans family. However, as it turns out, being a Wayans isn't all fun and games. Viewers see the good, the funny and the ugly as the young trio emerges from the long shadows of their uncles to carve out their own paths to stardom in Hollywood.
title: Second Generation Wayans

overview: Filipe, a municipal architect known for his idealism and commitment to environmental causes, is the only person who can stop the construction of a luxury real estate development in a protected area. Maria Rodrigues, a young prosecutor, is pursuing a lead in a high-level financial corruption case. At the same time, the reopening of a closed case, in which she was the victim, forces her to confront the deep and painful trauma of a night that took place 15 years before. As she takes the investigation into her own hands, she struggles with the hazy memories of the rape and hit-and-run. Filipe is one of the main suspects, but was it really him?
title: Madrugada Suja

overview: The drama is set in the heart of Tudor England against the backdrop of Anne Boleyn's arrest and weaves royal scandal with rural struggle. It centres around Anna, Mariella and Jane: three young women gossiping, arguing and dreaming in an Essex village, desperately waiting for their lives to start. When the news reaches them that King Henry VIII has had his Queen, Anne Boleyn, arrested, the three of them never suspect that this act will change their lives forever. As the weeks unfold, Anna, Jane and Mariella notice a rising tide of puritanism and misogyny. They attempt to navigate marriage, relationships, betrayals and births but as the fate of a Queen in a tower is sealed, they discover that being a woman in a volatile country is dangerous. As their own fates come into focus, the three try desperately to hold on to their friendship - but can it last or must they turn on each other to survive? A darkly comic and terrifyingly relevant story about friendship, sisterhood and a changing world, 1536 is a series that explores how the actions of a man in power changes the fate of working class women on the edges of the country. It asks if a King can murder his Queen, what does that mean for women elsewhere and how much have things really changed?

Adam's Law is a syndicated daytime courtroom reality series starring former two-term district attorney and TV judge Adam Levy—son of iconic television personality Judge Judy Sheindlin. Created and executive produced by Sheindlin, the show features Levy bringing his fierce, unfiltered, and meticulous legal approach to the bench to cut through noise and ferret out the absolute truth.
title: Adam's Law

overview: The enthusiasm is palpable, yet there don't seem to be enough causes to channel it into anymore. This sentiment might resonate with the modern young person and could very well be what inspired Adam Knight, the protagonist of Granada's new hour-long series 'Knight Errant '59,' to pursue his new venture. Adam Knight, portrayed by John Turner, is a young man who, after dabbling in various occupations, decides he wants a job that blends interest and excitement. He dubs himself Knight Errant and establishes a business to assist anyone in any situation. There's certainly no shortage of opportunities for him, and Adam, akin to a modern-day Sir Lancelot, finds himself continuously occupied. Assisting Adam is Liz Parish, a former newspaper columnist who left her position to become his indispensable partner. Liz embodies chicness, charm, wit, wisdom, sophistication, warmth, and quick wit. She's as ready to lend a helping hand as she is to deliver a clever remark. Her style reflects the fashion of 1959, occasionally venturing into 1960. Naturally, she is stunning. Rounding out the regular team in the Knight Errant setup is Peter Parker, played by Richard Carpenter. He's an earnest young writer absorbed in creating a major work. Full of the typical "angry young" affectations, Peter lacks one crucial thing: money. He's held various positions—from espresso bar attendant to office cleaner—that keep him afloat financially and, as he puts it, leave his mind free for more significant pursuits.
title: Knight Errant Limited

overview: High-energy clip show hosted by Larry the Cable Guy, who brings his signature heartland humor to a fast-paced collection of the funniest and most relatable clips from across the country.
title: American Mayhem

overview: A provincial girl, Anya, moves to the city of Tsvetaev by chance and due to her naivety, to work at the local television station. But no one in the established team at the news channel is expecting her. To assert her right to be there, Anya uncovers corruption schemes, looks for sponsors, and buys her colleagues coffee. Will Anya be able to become a news star in the big city, or will she return to her village to film stories about Nettle Day?
title: Новости

overview: The McGhee Sextuplets first captured the hearts of America after an online photo went viral and the entire family appeared on The Oprah Winfrey Show in 2011. Now for the first time in a new television docu-series, 6 Little McGhees follows the often chaotic, always love-filled lives of the unforgettable brood, as their parents struggle to balance the challenges of raising six toddlers with the demands of running their own business.
title: 6 Little McGhees

overview: Cha Do-hyeon and Yeo Eun-ho are neighbors and best friends who have grown up together, inseparable for 19 years. Eun-ho has always believed they are closer than family, never realizing that Do-hyeon's longtime crush has already gone far beyond friendship. When a transfer student suddenly enters their lives, jealousy and possessiveness push Do-hyeon to lose his composure. As his most familiar friend begins acting strangely, Eun-ho is forced to reconsider what their relationship really means. This summer, will 19 years of feelings finally cross the line?
title: Summertime

overview: MS NOW's Brandy Zadrozny's examines conspiracy theories.
title: The Deep End with Brandy Zadrozny

overview: You're with your loved one, or they're away from home in another country. Out of the blue they disappear. What do you do? What do the police and local authorities do? Where are they? What's happened? Are they alive or are they dead? Why have they vanished? Each episode of Last Seen On Holiday takes us deep inside a gripping mystery. A case of a British or American citizen who disappeared when they were away from home, abroad. Whether on holiday or working, each story will reveal the turmoil that families and friends go through when they don't know where their loved one is.
title: Last Seen On Holiday

overview: Check-In To Murder explores chilling true crimes that have shaken British communities, revealing how the line between picturesque and perilous can be razor thin. From quaint villages with rustic cottages to seafront towns lined with pastel-painted inns, Britain's nostalgic holiday destinations often attract couples, families and solo travellers - yet beneath these cheerful facades, some of the UK's most disturbing murders have taken place. This compelling series delves into crimes committed in and around the country's populous holiday towns and cities.
title: Check-In To Murder

overview: Meng Jiu Yi is a well-known "tabloid paparazzo," specializing in digging up celebrity gossip. While on assignment, she accidentally witnesses business tycoon heir Tan Yu Chen secretly meeting with an actress. Meng Jiu Yi secretly photographs them and slanders him as "impotent," causing a sensation across the city.
title: Shi Kong Bao Guang

overview: Renowned historian Bettany Hughes goes in search of the dawn of civilisations, embarking on an epic journey across ancient Anatolia, modern-day Türkiye. This is the story of where it all began.
title: Bettany Hughes Dawn of Civilisations

overview: A re-examination of Elvis Presley's meteoric rise and fall, seen through the lens of a shady Las Vegas, organised crime and Presley's mysterious manager, Colonel Tom Parker.
title: Elvis, the Colonel and the Mob

overview: After the cold winter, Yeon Ho and Yu Jun finally welcome a scorching summer
title: Summer Fever

overview: Front Office Sports Tonight, airing Monday through Friday and once on the weekend each week, is a 30-minute, nationally syndicated television show that goes beyond the field of play to break down the most important cultural, entertainment, and business stories in the world of sports with a mix of reporting, expert analysis, and commentary. The show explores the intersection of sports, culture, entertainment, and business—giving audiences an inside look at the power plays and personalities shaping the business and culture of sports.
title: Front Office Sports Tonight

overview: The series follows Vinnie Bassett, proprietor of a pop culture memorabilia store who only takes breaks to read comic books and play video games. His bachelor life comes to a halt when he assumes guardianship of his incredibly intelligent and mature nephew, Wendell. They soon find that 12-year-old Wendell may be just the parent Vinnie needs.
title: Wendell & Vinnie

overview: After spending over 20 years in prison for the murder of her friend Laura, Maja is released and returns to her hometown. At the age of 40, without a job or friends, she has no choice but to move back to her family home with her parents. Determined to leave the past behind and return to normal life, she tries to find her way among old corners and old acquaintances. She also clashes with the local community, which, however, remembers her mainly as a murderer from newspaper headlines.
title: Powrót do zycia

overview: The show follows two individuals, Lu Cheng and Lin Zhao, who jump straight into a rush-marriage and are forced to adjust to life as husband and wife under the same roof. Starting out as relative strangers bound by a marriage license, their initial awkwardness and cautious boundaries gradually melt away through daily domestic cohabitation, playful teasing, and undeniable romantic chemistry. As they navigate the realities of married life first, the two slowly drop their guard and fall genuinely in love, proving that romance can flourish after saying "I do."
title: Starting From Newlyweds

overview: Настолка is an energetic Russian comedy game show where hosts Andrey Beburishvili and Alexey Shalnov invite popular stand-up comedians and web personalities to face off in chaotic tabletop challenges. Blending traditional board game dynamics with interactive party rounds—spanning singing, drawing, trivia, and rapid-fire banter—the show trades strict rules for high-energy comedy as guests compete for bragging rights across a single tabletop battlefield.
title: Настолка

overview: Dek Seple follows Tin, a troubled young man who was separated from his family as a child and forced into a life of crime by a ruthless street gang. When a failed robbery leads him to seek refuge at a local school, Tin forms a life-changing bond with Kobkul, a kind student who sees his potential, and Kru Sak, a devoted teacher who fights to reform troubled youth. Unbeknownst to them, Kru Sak is actually Tin's long-lost biological father, setting off an emotional journey of survival, redemption, and a young man's struggle to break free from his dark past.
title: Dek Seple

overview: The critical developments during the coup attempt on July 15, 2016 in Türkiye, and the struggle given that night.
title: Asırlık Gece

overview: Dead End is a six-part crime drama based on true events. It tells the story of the hostage tragedy of August 1986 — the day that stopped all of Finland and forever changed police tactics.
title: Räjähdyspiste

overview: Yang Guan, a former racing champion, is framed and left struggling to keep his auto shop afloat. Just as he decides to sell his house to pay off his debts, his father dies after falling from a building, leaving behind an enormous financial burden. Desperate to repay what his father owed, Yang Guan stakes everything on a racing bet—only to suffer a crushing defeat and find himself buried even deeper in debt overnight. His life takes another unexpected turn when a little girl named Lele suddenly shows up and claims him as her father, forcing him to adjust to life as a single dad. Meanwhile, real estate agent Ye Zhiqiu, desperate to save her critically ill father, accepts a secret mission from Yang Guan's younger sister, Yang Ying. Under the guise of collecting a debt, she moves into Yang Guan's home while secretly searching for the research left behind by his father. Constant friction follows, but as Yang Guan and Ye Zhiqiu face one hardship after another together, their feelings gradually deepen. However, believing Yang Guan is responsible for their mother's death, Yang Ying sets a series of schemes in motion and publicly exposes Ye Zhiqiu's true identity as an undercover agent, shattering the trust between the couple. Determined to uncover the truth about his past, Yang Guan stages a livestreamed rooftop stunt that unexpectedly brings long-buried secrets to light. In the end, the true culprit is brought to justice, Yang Ying realizes her mistakes, and Yang Guan finally clears his debts and begins a new chapter with Ye Zhiqiu and Lele as a happy family.
title: Winner in Life
Ma！Zan Lia Ju Ben Na Fan Le

overview: A chef and a comedian have teamed up for an adventurous culinary experiment: can you cook a delicious, restaurant-quality dish absolutely anywhere, no matter the circumstances?
title: А тут?

overview: Hosted by Nick Lachey, The Winner Is… infuses the performance of a singing competition series and the strategy of a game show. Each episode features six acts that go head to head each week and sing for a shot at a $1 million grand prize. The aim of The Game is simple: Contestants must believe in their own performance, edge out their competition and avoid cash temptations to move forward.
title: The Winner Is...

overview: When Zhou Yan travels to Langia to find his fiancée, he is abducted by traffickers and trapped in a brutal scam compound, where he narrowly escapes having his organs harvested. But his ordeal is far from over. Framed for a crime he didn't commit, Zhou Yan is thrown in prison. After his release, he poses as a feared underworld kingpin and begins taking down local crime bosses and ruthless gangs one by one. Joining forces with undercover cops Mona and Layla, he uncovers the mastermind behind it all and fights his way to the top, bringing the entire criminal network crashing down.
title: The Outlaw

overview: When young Linda Bierwirth who grew up on a farm outside Munich—comes into contact with the pulsating techno scene in the mid-1990s, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery. Inspired by the subculture's electronic sound and lifestyle, she breaks away from her rural surroundings and moves to the big city with the goal of becoming a DJ
title: München Beats

overview: Steph challenges would-be dealers from all walks of life to battle it out in the competitive world of contemporary art. Who has an eye for a masterpiece and can bag a £50k prize?
title: The Big Deal with Steph McGovern

overview: Żywioły Saszy - Ogień follows Sasza Załuska, a skilled profiler who returns to Poland after seven years in Great Britain. She joins a police unit to solve a dangerous string of mysterious tenement fires in Łódź.
title: Żywioły Saszy – Ogień

overview: One travels for shopping, the other for social media. The only thing they have in common is their love of sports. Footballer Fyodor Smolov and blogger Lyosha Bigi travel to the world's biggest sporting events, available to watch on Okko — from the Olympics and the FIFA World Cup to the Ballon d'Or ceremony. But sport is merely an excuse to choose the destination. Their main mission is to complete a series of challenges set by an all-star team of experts. Along the way, the hosts will discover each city's iconic landmarks, sample the local cuisine, and uncover experiences that can surprise even the locals.
title: Чек-лист

overview: Life is a journey for Ben Hoffman, and he needs a lot of help navigating it. The comedian stars in a sketch show/man-on-the-street hybrid that sees him exploring the randomness of everyday existence. In each episode he sets a goal -- examples: Form a band. Buy a gun. Go on a blind date. -- and works toward it with the help of advice from family members, friends and complete strangers. The journeys interweave vignettes as well as sketches, and there are also original songs and animated pieces.
title: The Ben Show with Ben Hoffman

overview: After walking out on her drunken husband in Liverpool, Viv Sharpe travels to her native Bristol with her two children. There she finds that her mother has died and no one wants to know her or help her.
title: Fighting Back

overview: Young engineering masterminds and everyday kids pilot custom-built, remote-controlled remote-destruction machines into a high-octane arena combat tournament, battling rival bot-builders and mechanical hazards for ultimate supremacy.
title: Nickelodeon Robot Wars

overview: Sam, a Labrador Retriever, works with Officer Mike Breen. Despite showing excellent sensory and physical abilities on patrol, Captain Clagett remains skeptical of the K-9 program.
title: Sam
I Use Paper Figurines To Ward Off Hundreds Of Ghosts

overview: Like the plot of a Hollywood spy movie, the true story of a glamorous Russian spy who infiltrated UK society and America's corridors of power
title: Spy Next Door: The Anna Chapman Story

overview: Immerses yourself in the world of Welsh male voice choirs, featuring three distinct choirs from different parts of Wales, each facing unique challenges.
title: Voices of the Valleys

overview: NFL Hometown Eats combines football, food, and fandom in one delicious package. Each episode, a celebrity superfan teams up with an NFL player to explore the best restaurants around their home stadium.
title: NFL Hometown Eats

overview: From the network that has no business bringing you a cop show—it's Reno 911! Ride shotgun with the brave—and shameless—officers of the Reno Sheriff's Department for their unscripted adventures and high-octane thrills.
title: Reno 911!

overview: Produced by Latino Public Broadcasting, "Voces" is PBS' signature Latino arts and culture documentary showcase and the only ongoing national television series devoted to exploring and celebrating the rich diversity of the Latino cultural experience. Now in its fourth season, the new season of VOCES explores the ever-evolving relationship between Latino culture and the larger fabric of American society, from a classic movie set in remote Texas to modern day Hollywood to the frontlines of the drug war. The series is presented by PBS SoCaL and supported in part by the National Endowment for the Arts, the National Association of Latino Arts and Cultures, the Ford Foundation, and the Surdna Foundation through a grant from the NALAC Fund for the Arts Grant Program.
title: Voces
